name: health-necklace
description: Health Necklace: 1-button wearable voice assistant & Gemini AI speech interface built with p5.js.

scripts.build: node --check src/sketch.js && node --check src/gemini-assistant.js && node --check src/gemini-tts.js && node --check src/speech.js && node --check src/recognition.js && node --check src/sound.js && node --check src/portal/gamepad.js && node --check src/portal/portal.js && node --check src/portal/buttonEdge.js
scripts.sound: say -v Sara -r 165 -o /tmp/du_er_67.aiff "Du er 67 år gammel." && afconvert -f WAVE -d LEI16@44100 /tmp/du_er_67.aiff src/sounds/du_er_67.wav && afconvert -f m4af -d aac /tmp/du_er_67.aiff src/sounds/du_er_67.m4a
